title: crude glycerol biorefinery ofMicrobial consortium from anaerobic activated sludge
description: A microbial consortium capable of converting crude glycerol into high value-added bio-based products. This microbiome consists mainly of Klebsiella(56.82%), Enterococcus(38.26%), and Escherichia-Shigella(4.03%).The main products of this microbiome are lactic acid and 1,3 propanediol
samples: MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from activated sludge metagenome
explicit urban setting at sample level
